referenceProfile: Catalyst 9800 IOS XE 17.12 teaching subset / 9115 lightweight inspired / explicit generic standalone AP / generic PoE+
verificationBoundary: Repaired means demonstrated within the original simulator using source, parser, lifecycle and relevant packet/integration tests. It does not assert full Cisco firmware or Web GUI equivalence.

issues.reference: Centrally switched clients disassociate in standalone mode; established locally switched clients continue.
issues.before: The standalone advertisement path accepted central policies on Flex APs and retained their associations despite failed data tunnels.
issues.rootCause: Standalone eligibility did not inspect policy.centralSwitching.
issues.fix: Suppress central WLAN advertisements after CAPWAP loss; normal client evaluation disassociates central sessions, retaining local sessions and delivered traffic.
issues.remaining: Fresh FlexConnect authentication without its controller is not supported. The distinct generic standalone AP profile supports fresh local Open/WPA2-personal clients.

issues.reference: Per-band RF policies apply to their radio bands; AP service depends on its assigned site/RF/join/Flex configuration.
issues.before: Wrong-band references were accepted and missing RF/site/profile objects silently fell back to usable local radio defaults.
issues.rootCause: Reference lookups used optional chaining and permissive fallback for explicit missing dependencies.
issues.fix: Reject wrong-band CLI/persisted references. Missing explicit dependencies disable affected service; no fallback when a configured profile is missing. Correct RF tag prompt.
issues.remaining: Hardware-specific deletion protection/error wording and default-policy-tag behavior remain unverified/different.

issues.reference: Changing AP/Flex profile references in a site tag requires AP rejoin.
issues.before: Only AP tag names triggered rejoin; changed site profile references were hot-applied.
issues.rootCause: Rejoin signature compared assignment names but not the effective site profile references/mode.
issues.fix: Compare effective join/Flex references and site mode; enter REJOIN and accept configuration responses only during valid configure/run stages.
tests: AP policy tag changes trigger rejoin
issues.remaining: CAPWAP is structured simulated UDP; rejoin timer is compressed and DTLS is not implemented.

issues.feature: AP CLI reload under PoE-only power
issues.reference: An AP software reload resets volatile state while the connected PSE continues providing electrical power.
issues.before: Reload called power(false)/power(true), both intentionally ignored for AP nodes, retaining AP runtime/client state.
issues.rootCause: Manual electrical power and software restart shared an incompatible API.
issues.fix: Parent task adds Simulator.reload with a powered AP-specific runtime reset. PoE record/allocation remains; sessions clear and fresh management/CAPWAP lifecycle runs.
issues.remaining: No Cisco boot-loader/image execution; AP source remains exclusively PoE by user request.

issues.reference: Persisted configuration must not install malformed IDs, address objects, security switches or wrong-band references.
issues.before: Duplicate WLAN IDs and non-boolean AKM/WPA2 flags were accepted. A non-string primary address could reach packet logic.
issues.rootCause: Incomplete type/range validation of optional wireless fields and cross-profile IDs/bands.
issues.fix: Validate unique WLAN IDs, boolean security flags, primary address/name/interface types, and matching RF bands before replacing topology state.
issues.remaining: Complete malformed-input matrix for every optional dictionary property is still pending.

issues.reference: Configured request timeouts/retransmissions precede ordered server failover. A delivered rejection remains authoritative.
issues.before: Only the first group server was used; retransmit was ignored and the client always aborted after 12 seconds.
issues.rootCause: Authentication selected one server and used an unrelated fixed association deadline.
issues.fix: Use delivered UDP requests with per-server timeout/retransmit, ordered fallback only on unavailable server, total bounded association deadline, and runtime/generation cancellation guards. Emit real request/accept/reject/timeout events.
issues.remaining: Logical password-based EAP; no PEAP/TLS, RADIUS deadtime/load-balancing/accounting/CoA. Shared-secret reject behavior is the existing simulated AAA service abstraction.

issues.reference: Applying represented GUI fields must preserve unrelated running settings and remain synchronized with CLI/runtime.
issues.before: The form rebuilt every profile from defaults, clearing disabled CLI security flags, descriptions, RF channel and Flex properties. Duplicate rows silently merged; empty RF selections were not always removed.
issues.rootCause: Whole-table reconstruction coupled to DOM traversal without explicit preserved-field semantics.
issues.fix: Extract controllerFormDraft; preserve unrepresented fields, validate every select/duplicate row via parser/draft, explicitly clear RF mappings, retain off-topology assignments and honor deletion of presented AP overrides.
issues.remaining: 44 current WLC field templates inventoried; full vendor GUI and every per-field boundary/reload/hardware comparison remain incomplete.

issues.reference: An unannounced remote AP failure is learned from failed CAPWAP liveness, while its local radios stop when power is removed.
issues.before: WLC polling inspected the simulator's AP power flag and immediately deleted registration without any missed control packet timer.
issues.rootCause: Global topology knowledge bypassed the modeled CAPWAP control plane.
issues.fix: Expire controller registrations from last delivered AP control message and configured dead interval; emit timeout log/event. Restore actual join after PoE returns.
issues.remaining: Three-heartbeat dead-time model is an explicit abstraction rather than a complete Cisco retry/DTLS liveness implementation.

issues.reference: Packet/byte statistics must count actual adapter data traffic.
issues.before: Wireless send and receive bypassed the shared count hooks, so active clients showed no Wireless0 packet/byte totals.
issues.rootCause: The wireless branch returned before wired counting; wireless ingress called receiveFrame directly.
issues.fix: Count authorized Wireless0 transmission/received frames through existing engine counters and observation hooks; preserve wired/QoS paths.
issues.remaining: These are modeled data-frame counters, not physical 802.11 retry/FCS/radio counters.

issues.reference: A supplied argument must either take its documented effect or reject explicitly.
issues.before: Existing WLAN commands accepted a different ID but retained the old ID; GUI appeared to accept an edit without effect.
issues.rootCause: Creation used nullish assignment without validating immutable identity on subsequent full-form commands.
issues.fix: Reject changed existing identity transactionally and make existing GUI IDs read-only; creation still validates unique IDs.
issues.remaining: Exact release-specific Cisco ID-edit error wording and supported recreation workflow require reference runtime capture.

issues.reference: DNS list edits replace the displayed selection; SSID bytes are not silently changed; IPv6 fields reject IPv4 CIDRs.
issues.before: WLC DNS Apply appended to old resolvers; SSIDs were trimmed; AP/laptop IPv6 input accepted any CIDR family; invalid address-mode strings fell through to static.
issues.rootCause: Generic trim/read helper, additive IOS name-server command, and insufficient form-specific validation.
issues.fix: Clear/reapply DNS list, preserve raw SSID bytes, validate IPv6 family and IPv4 address-mode enum.
issues.remaining: Full IPv6 GUI renewal/default/negation and reload matrix remains partial.

issues.feature: Inherited-member names in user-defined wireless dictionaries
issues.reference: Legal IOS-style profile names must remain data and must not inherit JavaScript object members or mutate prototypes.
issues.before: Names such as constructor and __proto__ could resolve inherited functions or the prototype setter during profile creation/lookups; GUI retention could clone an inherited function. Global persistence rejection also prevented otherwise legal names from reloading.
issues.rootCause: Plain-object dictionary lookup/creation did not consistently require own entries.
issues.fix: Use own-property lookup and defineProperty insertion across wireless CLI, form retention, RF validation, AAA references and operational diagnostics. Parent persistence validator permits only dictionary entry positions while recursively rejecting unsafe ordinary child fields.
issues.remaining: Regression names cover constructor, __proto__, toString and hasOwnProperty; full fuzzing of every saved dictionary shape remains outside this evidence.

issues.reference: Reference labels must reflect the same enabled state edited by each current form control.
issues.before: The targeted WLC browser reproduced CAMPUS · Campus · Disabled for the enabled CAMPUS WLAN. Enabled policy and RF rows used the same incorrect path.
issues.rootCause: bindWLCReferences read .checked from controls rendered as on/off select elements.
issues.fix: Read on/off values for HTMLSelectElement and checked state for checkboxes; preserve the live unsaved catalog and unavailable selections.
issues.remaining: Exact Cisco GUI visual equivalence and all per-field default/negation/reload cases remain partial.

issues.feature: Implicit Enterprise authentication and non-destructive Apply
issues.reference: The existing runtime selects the default dot1x list when WLAN.authenticationList is absent. Equivalent defaults must not silently become a client configuration change.
issues.before: The new dropdown showed an invalid blank even when the implicit default list worked. The draft made implicit authentication/true security flags explicit, changing runtime signatures and forcing avoidable client reauthentication on unrelated Apply.
issues.rootCause: GUI default selection did not match runtime fallback, and draft normalization changed semantically equivalent optional properties.
issues.fix: Select an available own default method list for an implicit existing Enterprise profile; preserve absent authentication/AKM/WPA2 fields when mode and implicit choice are unchanged. Missing lists still block transactionally.
issues.remaining: Full GUI preservation matrix for every optional CLI-only setting remains partial.

issues.reference: Pinned Catalyst9800 IOS XE17.12 configuration guides and source-backed shared simulator services; documented teaching invariants only.
issues.before: Existing shared AAA, clock, log, SNMP and HTTPS services had no WLC administration workflow.
issues.rootCause: No WLC form-to-shared-command binding.
issues.fix: Add validated atomic administration for named RADIUS/TACACS servers/groups and dot1x lists, management users/default login, NTP/syslog/SNMPv2c/HTTPS; retain advanced properties.
issues.evidence: WADM-01/02/12/15; seven-check WLC administration browser artifact

issues.feature: Wireless IPv4 ACL and QoS binding
issues.reference: Pinned Catalyst9800 IOS XE17.12 configuration guides and source-backed shared simulator services; documented teaching invariants only.
issues.before: Wireless policy profiles carried VLAN/switching only; existing shared ACL/QoS could not be attached at the wireless edge.
issues.rootCause: No wireless packet policy integration or delivered Flex dependency snapshot.
issues.fix: Bind existing IPv4 ACLs and four aggregate/client direction QoS slots to actual packets. CAPWAP delivers ACL/class/policy/time-range dependencies to Flex APs; real shared counters and policers apply; queue-only policies reject.
issues.evidence: WADM-06/07/08/14 both central and Flex and all direction slots

issues.feature: AP join authorization and controller actions
issues.reference: Pinned Catalyst9800 IOS XE17.12 configuration guides and source-backed shared simulator services; documented teaching invariants only.
issues.before: Joining APs bypassed configurable MAC authorization; controller UI lacked deauthentication and startup save/reload.
issues.rootCause: No AP local/RADIUS admission gate or management action lifecycle bindings.
issues.fix: Add native local/RADIUS AP authorization with delivered retries/failover, explicit-reject stop, lifecycle/AAA dependency cancellation, remote-database recovery and fresh authorization after a later rejoin; completed result reuse is bounded to duplicate retries. Monitor actual results. Send real CAPWAP disconnect; save through write memory and reload actual startup lifecycle.
issues.evidence: WADM-03/04/05/10/11/13/16; live remote MAC revocation after a 95-second WLC outage; WLC administration browser AP PoE restart, disconnect and save/reload

issues.reference: Pinned Catalyst9800 IOS XE17.12 configuration guides and source-backed shared simulator services; documented teaching invariants only.
issues.before: Only open and WPA2 modes could associate; SAE/PMF workflow absent.
issues.rootCause: Missing security schema, native SAE/PMF parser, negotiation and handshake lifecycle.
issues.fix: Add native WPA3/SAE and transition modes; logical commit/confirm bound to randomized session context, password mismatch before association/key exchange, PMF admission, negotiated per-client mode, persistence and GUI. This is not elliptic-curve SAE, CCMP encryption or interoperability.
issues.evidence: WPA3-01–04 real central/Flex DHCP/ICMP/HTTP, failures, Windows/Cisco labels, export/reload; WLC administration browser wrong/correct SAE key

issues.reference: Pinned Catalyst9800 IOS XE17.12 configuration guides and source-backed shared simulator services; documented teaching invariants only.
issues.before: Requesting context help assigned policy.name during command registry construction.
issues.rootCause: Policy name initialization occurred outside command execution.
issues.fix: Initialize the name only in the native create command; registry/help/completion have no configuration writes.
issues.evidence: WPA3-05 config byte equality before/after policy/WLAN help and completion

issues.reference: Pinned Catalyst9800 IOS XE17.12 configuration guides and source-backed shared simulator services; documented teaching invariants only.
issues.before: The added 802.3af reduced-power supply exposed two streams but wireless data rate and AP diagnostics did not consume it.
issues.rootCause: Rate calculation had no electrical stream constraint.
issues.fix: Apply allocated spatial-stream ratio to actual wireless delivery rate and expose effective streams in received AP diagnostics; default four-stream rate stays unchanged.
issues.evidence: WADM-09 actual half-rate, diagnostics and ping; parent POE-14 supply/save-load

issues.reference: CCNA v2.0 objective 2.2.b and Cisco autonomous SSID/VLAN configuration reference; explicit generic teaching profile, not autonomous C9115 firmware.
issues.before: A fresh AP could only receive WLANs through a WLC. Cached Flex outage sessions did not provide a fresh standalone AP configuration/authentication workflow.
issues.rootCause: AP operating profile, local SSID/radio bindings and local configuration authority were absent. Factory reload also replaced an unsaved standalone profile with the default lightweight profile.
issues.fix: Add an explicit generic-standalone profile and atomic local SSID/security/VLAN/radio GUI/native subset. Reuse real RF/authentication/association/Ethernet bridging, require working PoE, remove local service when returning to lightweight, and retain the selected profile independently of saved configuration during software reload.
issues.evidence: SAP-01 through SAP-08; docs/audits/standalone-ap-browser-validation.json seven production-GUI checks; combined wireless scoped run99/99
issues.remaining: Open/WPA2-personal local security only; full autonomous IOS firmware, BVI/subinterfaces/bridge groups and native radio cryptography are outside this profile.

issues.feature: Standalone GUI preserves native radio/cipher configuration
issues.before: An SSID with no radio attachments rendered as attached to both radios. Mixed per-band AES settings rendered Disabled, and unrepresented cipher VLAN entries were rebuilt away on Apply.
issues.rootCause: The initial GUI collapsed no attachment and mixed per-band states into defaults and reconstructed the full cipher list from represented SSIDs.
issues.fix: Represent Unattached and Keep existing per-radio ciphers explicitly. Preserve native cipher VLAN entries, applying Enabled/Disabled only to the selected VLAN and radios.
issues.evidence: Existing SAP-06 now asserts unchanged unattached and asymmetric settings, retention of unrepresented VLAN77, and explicit AES disable; SAP-02 asserts actual attachment/cipher data dependencies.

issues.feature: Native ASCII versus hexadecimal PSK boundaries
issues.before: The ASCII native key form accepted64 hexadecimal characters because the generic key validator also accepts a raw64-digit hexadecimal PSK.
issues.rootCause: The ASCII branch did not apply its distinct8–63 printable-character length requirement.
issues.fix: Apply the ASCII8–63 and hexadecimal64-digit constraints to their respective native forms before any configuration mutation.
issues.evidence: Existing SAP-05 and WPA3-05 reject ASCII64-hex and short-hex input and assert unchanged configuration.

issues.before: No interface Dot11Radio0/1, including the spaced interface dot11radio form, entered the radio context instead of rejecting removal of a fixed physical interface.
issues.rootCause: The dedicated radio entry handlers ignored the negation flag.
issues.fix: Reject fixed radio removal before mode or configuration changes; normal interface entry remains supported. Default forms already reject before the handler.
issues.evidence: Windows parser retained observations reproduced all three advertised variants; existing SAP-05 now checks four fixed-radio no forms preserve configuration and remain in config mode.

additionalVerifiedScenarios.behavior: Hidden directed preferred SSID remains joinable; unknown client scan does not expose it. Configured session expiry causes a fresh four-way handshake.
